correctness.rationale: Expand each cycle sign product as sum_{F subset A}(-2)^|F| N_n(F). For F with t<=n-3 that is extendible, its components are disjoint paths and orientation count yields N_n(F)=2^(h-1)(n-t-1)!; otherwise N_n(F)=0. Legendre valuation and s2(n-1-t)<=s2(n-1) for the binary-digit family give divisibility by 2^(nu2(M)+1). For t>=n-2 factor 2^t alone suffices. The empty subset is M, whose valuation is n-2-s2(n-1). This establishes exact nonvanishing for every signing without relying on finite enumeration. Independently enumerated 12 unoriented K5 cycles and 20160 unoriented K9 cycles: negative one-edge n5 splits 6:6 and negative K4 n9 has counts 1440,8640,8640,1440, alternating sum 0. The code includes a separate Held-Karp signed-DP and finite full Walsh support test; source was inspected, but those runs do not replace the proof.
